```
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB
VAR_INPUT ...

VAR_IN_OUT...
VAR
 count : DINT :=0;
 head : DINT :=1;
 tail : DINT :=1;
 enPrev: BOOL;
 dePrev: BOOL;
 enRise: BOOL;
 deRise: BOOL;
END_VAR

enRise := enqueue AND NOT enPrev;
deRise := dequeue AND NOT dePrev;

IF reset THEN
 count:=0; head:=1; tail:=1; status:=0;
ELSE
 status:=0;
 IF enRise AND NOT deRise THEN
   IF count < capacity THEN
      buffer[tail]:=item;
      IF tail >= capacity THEN tail:=1; ELSE tail:=tail+1; END_IF;
      count:=count+1;
   ELSE status:=16#8002;
   END_IF
 ELSIF deRise AND NOT enRise THEN
   IF count>0 THEN
      item:=buffer[head];
      IF head>=capacity THEN head:=1; ELSE head:=head+1; END_IF;
      count:=count-1;
   ELSE status:=16#8001;
   END_IF
 END_IF
END_IF

enPrev:=enqueue;
dePrev:=dequeue;
elementCount:=count;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
```
